title: Wayfare Bikes and Scooters Plan Conditions: Refund Windows on Cancellation, Suspension and Plan Changes
content:
Per-plan settings of the Wayfare Bikes and Scooters plans for cancellation refunds, suspension for unpaid charges, reinstatement and moving between plans.

## Settings by plan

| Plan | Full refund of an unused plan on cancellation within (calendar days after purchase) | Annual plans refunded pro rata after the full-refund window | Suspended while any bike charge is unpaid |
|---|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Bikes Pay As You Ride | 0 (never) | No | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Day Pass | 1 | No | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass | 0 (never) | No | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Access Annual | 14 | No | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual | 14 | No | Yes |
| Wayfare Bikes Annual Plus | 14 | No | Yes |

The following three terms are the same on all six plans listed above.

| Term | Wording on every plan |
|---|---|
| Unused plan | A plan is unused when no ride has been started under it. |
| Reinstatement | A suspended plan is reinstated when every unpaid charge is paid; the term is not extended for the suspension. |
| Moving to another plan | Moving to another plan cancels the current plan under its own refund rule and buys the new one. |

## Notes

1. The full-refund window is counted in calendar days after purchase. A figure of 0 means an unused plan is never refunded in full on cancellation; that is the case for Pay As You Ride and for the Monthly Pass.
2. The Day Pass window is 1 calendar day after purchase; the three annual plans have 14.
3. No annual plan is refunded pro rata once its full-refund window has passed.
4. Suspension for an unpaid bike charge applies on every plan, and reinstatement never lengthens the term.

## Hypothetical readings

- A Wayfare Bikes Annual plan bought on 1 May, with no ride started under it and cancelled on 9 May, is cancelled 8 calendar days after purchase, inside its 14-day window.
- The same plan cancelled on 20 June is outside the window, and as an annual plan it is not refunded pro rata.
- A Wayfare Bikes Monthly Pass, with a window of 0, has no full-refund period at all.
- A plan suspended for 10 days and then reinstated keeps its original last valid day.
